item.title: Litter in front of school every day, 12th October
item.description:
The council needs to do something about it and start issuing fines asap - putting more bins out or just doing a weekly clean up won't fix the problem because people just drop litter wherever they please (regardless of whether a bin is nearby or not). What kind of message does this amount of rubbish in a children's play area / in front of a school send to kids? If you start actually issuing fines and regularly patrolling this area for fly tipping, people will stop littering.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Belson Road, Woolwich
